purpose: Prospective evaluation contract for the first v3.2 causal-neighborhood forward sample.
entryRule: next executable A-share trading session open after the frozen week-end date 2026-09-25
rationale: 60 trading days remains the cross-run comparison horizon; 20d measures event repricing and 120d checks persistence without choosing the best horizon after the fact.
forwardGuardrails: No outcome or post-entry price data may alter the frozen discovery pack, mappings, expectation snapshot or underwriter decisions.
Do not promote a No selection cluster after observing later winners.
Post-outcome misses may diagnose source, association, verification, mapping or underwriting failure but may not tune the reported v3.2 sample.
Any rule change motivated by this sample must be tested on a later untouched sample.
